title: Bind the historical audit engine to immutable evidence protection
objective: Define a fail-closed requalification layer that binds ENG-07 read-only audit artifacts and remediation metadata to the existing historical evidence protection authority, proving that audit findings reports and queues cannot authorize mutation of certified evidence.
non_goals: perform remediation or create write-capable remediation tooling
modify Lot44 or Lot45 certification facts
modify business code contracts data/audit or certified reports
integrate new CI steps in this WU

required_invariants: engineering/HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_PROTECTION.json remains the canonical historical immutability authority
canonical Lot44 and Lot45 Git anchors and protected current-tree paths must pass the existing evidence-protection validator unchanged
all historical findings and report mutation permissions remain false
remediation queue data is advisory metadata and conveys no repository write authority
ENG-07 audit validators contain no filesystem repository network or subprocess mutation primitive
every ENG-07 operational AWU keeps business code contracts data/audit and certified report paths outside its allowed scope
future remediation requires a separate explicitly authorized work item and may not silently rewrite certified historical evidence
Lot45 candidate and Lot46 remain outside the historical audit engine authority
acceptance_criteria: existing historical evidence protection validates unchanged
audit findings/report policies are confirmed read-only with all mutation permissions false
audit validators are statically qualified as no-write governance code
all ENG-07 AWU allowlists are disjoint from frozen evidence prefixes
report queue schema/policy exposes no command patch target-path branch or write-authority field
forged writable permissions write primitive protected-path scope or weakened canonical anchor binding fails closed in built-in synthetic self-check
no protected evidence file is modified by WU01
adversarial test module and CI integration are deferred to ENG-07.6-WU02

done_when: audit-engine read-only semantics are explicitly bound to canonical historical evidence protection
no-write validator and AWU-scope requalification is deterministic and fail closed
adversarial qualification and CI integration are delegated to ENG-07.6-WU02
